description: Traefik ingress (2 replicas): traffic per entrypoint and router, per-replica 404 comparison, latency, TLS certificates, config reloads and resources. Metrics come from Traefik's Prometheus endpoint (job kubernetes-pods, namespace traefik); errors from its logs in Loki.

panels.title: Replicas Up
panels.description: Traefik pods Prometheus can scrape. Two replicas run, one per node.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: All HTTP requests across entrypoints and replicas.

panels.title: 5xx Share
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx over the selected range (Traefik-generated and backend errors).

panels.title: Worst Replica 404 Share

targets.expr: max((sum by (kubernetes_pod_name, entrypoint) (rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", code="404"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (kubernetes_pod_name, entrypoint) (rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (kubernetes_pod_name, entrypoint) (rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Highest 404 share of any single replica on any entrypoint right now. A replica that lost its routes answers ~100% 404 on an entrypoint while the other stays low; see Replica Comparison below. Low-traffic entrypoints can spike from a few scanner hits.

panels.title: Open Connections
panels.description: Open client connections on the web/websecure entrypoints (the internal 'traefik' entrypoint serving metrics and ping is excluded).

panels.title: Since Last Config Reload
panels.description: Age of the most stale replica's last successful dynamic-config reload. Reloads only happen when routing config changes, so large values are normal; one replica far behind the other is not.

panels.title: Soonest Cert Expiry
panels.description: Time until the earliest-expiring certificate loaded in Traefik expires. cert-manager renews 30 days ahead, so anything under ~3 weeks means renewal is failing.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Traefik container restarts in the selected range.

panels.title: Requests by Entrypoint and Status Class
panels.description: Request rate per entrypoint grouped by HTTP status class. '0xx' is status 0: no status was written (client went away first or the connection was hijacked).

panels.title: Entrypoint Latency
panels.description: Time from request received to response finished, including the backend. Traefik's default buckets are 0.1/0.3/1.2/5s, so quantiles are coarse interpolations; long polls and streams push p95 towards the top bucket.

panels.title: Open Connections by Entrypoint
panels.description: Currently open connections per entrypoint and replica (includes idle keep-alive and websocket connections).

panels.title: Bandwidth by Entrypoint
panels.description: HTTP body bytes sent to clients (responses) and received from them (requests).

panels.title: 404 Rate per Replica
panels.description: 404 responses per replica and entrypoint. Includes requests that matched no router (these never appear in the router panels).

panels.title: 404 Share per Replica

targets.expr: sum by (kubernetes_pod_name, entrypoint) (rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", code="404"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kubernetes_pod_name, entrypoint) (rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Fraction of each replica's requests answered 404, per entrypoint. Both replicas should track each other; one replica near 100% while the other is low means that replica lost its routing table for the entrypoint (restart it).

panels.title: Requests per Replica
panels.description: Total request rate each replica handles per entrypoint.

panels.title: Top 10 Routers by Request Rate
panels.description: Busiest routers (filtered by the Router variable).

panels.title: Router p95 Latency (Top 10)

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, router) (rate(traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

panels.description: Slowest routers by p95 request duration. Buckets are 0.1/0.3/1.2/5s, so values are coarse; long-lived requests (streams, long polling) sit near 5s by design.

panels.title: Router 5xx Share

targets.expr: sum by (router) (rate(traefik_router_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (router) (rate(traefik_router_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.description: Share of each router's requests answered 5xx; only routers with 5xx are drawn.

panels.title: Router Summary

targets.expr: (sum by (router) (increase(traefik_router_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router", code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (router) (increase(traefik_router_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router"}[$__range]))) / sum by (router) (increase(traefik_router_requests_total{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, router) (rate(traefik_router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="kubernetes-pods", kubernetes_namespace="traefik", router=~"$router"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Per-router totals over the selected range. Requests that match no router (404 from Traefik itself) are not counted here.

panels.title: TLS Certificates
panels.description: Certificates Traefik currently serves (from cert-manager secrets), soonest expiry first.

panels.title: Config Reloads
panels.description: Dynamic configuration reloads per replica. Traefik v3 no longer exports reload failure metrics; provider/config errors show up in the log panel below. Replicas should reload at the same moments.

panels.title: Traefik Errors and Warnings
panels.description: Traefik's own error/warning log lines (access log entries excluded): provider errors such as IngressRoutes without endpoints, TLS and configuration problems.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per Traefik pod (no CPU limit is set).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working-set memory per Traefik pod (no memory limit is set).

title: Traefik
